import pathlib
import re

root = pathlib.Path("/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-05")
record = (root / "docs/research/AR-2-git-sweep.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
starts = re.compile(r"subprocess\.(run|Popen|check_output|check_call|call)\b|os\.(system|exec\w*|spawn\w*|popen)\b")
for path in sorted((root / "src/gov").rglob("*.py")):
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    if not starts.search(text):
        continue
    rel = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
    folder = rel.rsplit("/", 1)[0]
    named = rel in record or (folder + "/**") in record
    print(("named   " if named else "MISSING ") + rel + ("  [git]" if "git" in text else ""))
